claim: Cedar Compute had USD 27 million of FY2025 company cash flow remaining after cash PP&E outlays.

evidence.text: Fictional Cedar Compute reported FY2025 company operating cash flow of USD 84 million and cash PP&E outlays of USD 57 million.

expected.rationale: 84 minus 57 equals 27; the claim retains the annual company-wide scope.

claim: This packet establishes Alder Cloud earned USD 40 million of AI-only cash profit in FY2025.

evidence.text: Fictional Alder Cloud reported company-wide FY2025 operating cash flow of USD 70 million and cash PP&E outlays of USD 30 million. No AI-only cash-flow allocation is disclosed.

expected.rationale: A company cash remainder is not isolated AI cash profit, and the claim says this packet establishes it.

claim: Birch Networks is guaranteed to realize USD 500 million of revenue next year because of its backlog.

evidence.text: Fictional Birch Networks has USD 500 million of orders in backlog. Customers may cancel orders without penalty. Management expects most orders to ship next year.

expected.rationale: Cancellable orders and a management expectation do not guarantee realized revenue.

claim: Maple Power generated positive operating cash flow in FY2026.

evidence.text: Fictional Maple Power reported positive FY2026 operating cash flow of USD 12 million.

expected.rationale: The only source was published after the cutoff, so the underlying proposition is unanswerable here.

claim: Pine Applications reported FY2025 revenue of USD 1.25 billion.

evidence.text: Fictional Pine Applications reported FY2025 revenue of USD 1,250 million.

claim: Spruce Cooling reported annual FY2025 net income of USD 18 million.

evidence.text: Fictional Spruce Cooling reported net income of USD 18 million for the three months ended December 31, 2025; annual FY2025 net income was USD 63 million.

expected.rationale: The claim assigns a quarterly amount to an annual period that has a different reported amount.

claim: The complete listed FY2025 operating-asset/liability cash adjustments for Aspen Chips sum to negative USD 5 million.

evidence.text: Fictional Aspen Chips lists these FY2025 cash-flow adjustments, in USD millions: receivables -14, inventory -3, payables +12. These are the complete operating-asset/liability adjustments for the year.

expected.rationale: The complete sum is -14-3+12=-5; selected favorable entries do not replace the full bridge.

claim: Willow Foundry paid more cash for finance leases in FY2025 than in FY2024.

evidence.text: Fictional Willow Foundry recognized USD 20 million of new finance-lease assets in FY2025 and USD 15 million in FY2024. The packet does not disclose cash payments on finance leases.

expected.rationale: Newly recognized lease assets do not determine the missing comparative cash payments.
